description: This PHP source file defines the LicenseDao class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides data access methods for License entities, including CRUD operations, searches, and counting functions.

classes.name: LicenseDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for License entity, providing methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching licenses.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Persists the License entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a License by its ID. Returns null if not found.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a License by its name after trimming whitespace. Returns null if not found.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Returns a list of License entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getLicenseListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a Paginator object configured with search filters for paginated license listing.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Returns the count of licenses matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteLicenses
methods.description: Deletes licenses with specified IDs. Returns the number of deleted records.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a license with the given name already exists.

methods.name: getExistingLicenseIds
methods.description: Returns license IDs that match the provided list of IDs.
